sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: NanoBiT-Gi1 dissociation assay: receptor coupled to Gi1 upon agonist stimulation, demonstrating surface expression and functional G protein coupling with the FLAG tag present.
sites.rationale: CXCR2 has no endogenous signal peptide (topology string contains no 'S'; residues 1–49 are extracellular). The paper adds an exogenous HA-derived signal sequence upstream of a FLAG tag, so after signal-peptide cleavage the FLAG tag sits immediately before canonical Met1, placing it at insert_after_residue = 0. This is the sole extracellular terminus of the receptor (the C-terminus, residues 318–360, is intracellular), so the position is topology-derived. The tag is 50 residues from the TM1 boundary (residue 50), well clear of any TM constraint. The NanoBiT-Gi1 assay requires a surface-expressed, G-protein-coupling-competent receptor, confirming both trafficking and function are preserved. Full-length membrane-anchored CXCR2 expressed with an exogenous HA-derived signal sequence followed by a FLAG-epitope tag at the N-terminus; construct used in NanoBiT-Gi1 protein dissociation assays in a mammalian cell system (PMC10336096).

sources.claim: Specifically, a NanoBiT-Gi1 protein consisting of Gαi1 subunit fused with a large fragment (LgBiT) at the α-helical domain (between the residues 91 and 92 of Gαi1) and an N-terminally small fragment (SmBiT)-fused Gγ2 subunit with a C68S mutation was expressed along with untagged Gβ1 subunit and CXCR1 or CXCR2 (containing the N-terminal HA-derived signal sequence followed by the FLAG-epitope tag).

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) is provided. It reports a full-length, membrane-anchored CXCR2 construct bearing an N-terminal FLAG tag (preceded by an exogenous HA-derived signal sequence) used in a NanoBiT-Gi1 functional assay. No residue number is stated in the clip, but CXCR2 has exactly one extracellular terminus (N-terminus, residues 1–49; no endogenous signal peptide), so the position is unambiguously topology-derived at insert_after_residue = 0. No other insertion sites (internal loops ECL1 107–120, ECL2 183–208, ECL3 274–294, or C-terminal) are supported by any ledger line and are therefore not proposed.
